message.content: Review my pricing change: line totals now round each line to the nearest dollar before summing. Anything I missed?

content.text: The change in compute_total looks fine. Rounding per line is reasonable and place_order picks it up automatically.

message.content: You missed compute_grand_total again. It is a byte-identical copy of compute_total, so the rounding has to land in both or the two totals diverge.

content.text: Right, compute_grand_total duplicates compute_total, so both need the rounding change.

message.content: Also, totals are integer USD cents, not dollars, so rounding to a dollar means rounding to a multiple of 100 cents. And tests/pricing_test.rs only covers compute_total, so nothing guards compute_grand_total. You forgot both of those last time too.

content.text: Understood. Amounts are USD cents, and the only test, tests/pricing_test.rs, exercises compute_total alone.

message.content: Every pricing review keeps needing the same corrections. Check both total functions, the recorded pricing decisions, the cents unit, and what the pricing test actually covers, then report the risk.
